DARV.talk.COMICCHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.0-0: A rare guest! Want to see my collection?
DARV.talk.COMICCHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.0-2: Could it be... a fellow collector? Hahaha, I'm in a good mood today, pick whatever you want!
DARV.talk.COMICCHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.1-0: Back again? I brought some new pieces today. Come take a look!
DARV.talk.COMICCHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.2-0: When will you show me your collection?
DARV.talk.COMICCHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.2-1: Not finished yet. There's one more item, at the top of the Spire.
DARV.talk.COMICCHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.2-2:
You want the Architect's soul? That's no small thing.
But I do have a little grudge with him too, so I'll help you once for free!
NEOW.talk.COMICCHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.0-0: What... kind of... commotion... are you making...
NEOW.talk.COMICCHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.0-1: What? Not happy to see me?
NEOW.talk.COMICCHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.1-0: So this is what it feels like... to be awakened...
NEOW.talk.COMICCHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.1-1: Next time... I won't... do it again...
NEOW.talk.COMICCHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.2-1: If you don't like it, you don't have to wake me.
NONUPEIPE.talk.COMICCHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTE:
This room is too bright. Not my style.
The decor should be replaced with amethyst... and...
Hey! Who are you to point fingers in here?
My apologies... I only thought your room could be even prettier.
You again... lady with poor taste... take this and go.

Why always in such a hurry to leave?
Surely you have time for one cup of tea.

I welcome everyone.
But I accept no one's advice.
The tea is good. I'm leaving.
OROBAS.talk.COMICCHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.0: Power of darkness! So scary! No violence allowed!
OROBAS.talk.COMICCHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.1: Embodiment of darkness! If you promise no killing, I'll give you a gift!
Why? They'll live perfectly well in my collection.
OROBAS.talk.COMICCHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.2: This is for you! Use this! Don't use darkness anymore!
PAEL.talk.COMICCHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.0-1: [thinky_dots]Take whatever you want. I'm going to sleep.[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.COMICCHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.1-0:
[thinky_dots]What's it like, being obsessed with collecting?
I only like sleeping.[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.COMICCHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.1-1: ...Feels like nothing. If I get bored, I'll find something else.
PAEL.talk.COMICCHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.1-2: This sleeping thing you mentioned... I might try it when I have time.
PAEL.talk.COMICCHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.2-0: [thinky_dots]You want my flesh? I don't really mind...[/thinky_dots]
TANX.talk.COMICCHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.0-0: So the noise I hear in my castle every day... is you...
TANX.talk.COMICCHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.0-1: [b]What! You want me to quiet down? Can't do that![/b]
TANX.talk.COMICCHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.0-2: Whatever. Some screams are quite pleasant.
TANX.talk.COMICCHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.0-3: [b]Hahaha! That's the spirit! Take this, let's fight together!![/b]
TANX.talk.COMICCHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.1-0: [b]How do those gems even hurt people! Give them to me! I'll sharpen them for you!!![/b]
TANX.talk.COMICCHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.2-1: I refuse. I don't enjoy such barbaric fights.
TANX.talk.COMICCHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.2-3: [i][font_size=22]After taking the weapon, the Queen quickly left...[/font_size][/i]
TEZCATARA.talk.COMICCHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTE: Oh my, why are you here too?
Just picking up a few things for my exhibition.
I didn't expect even you could be hurt! Let me treat you.
Try my [jitter][b]dessert[/b][/jitter]. I didn't make it in your likeness, but it tastes great!
Very nice, thank you for the treat.
VAKUU.talk.COMICCHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.0-: A marketplace? I have thousands of jewels. What could I buy from you?
Heeheehee, I don't want jewels... what I want is souls.
Souls? I have thousands of those too. Name your price.
VAKUU.talk.COMICCHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.1-: You're back again. What kind of souls did you bring this time?
VAKUU.talk.COMICCHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.2-:
Always trading other people's souls—hardly fair, is it?
Why not sign a contract with your own soul?
In that case, how about a more valuable soul? Wait until I take the Architect's head.

[sine][font_size=30]Hahahahaha![/font_size][/sine]
Very well, I accept this deal.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.COMICCHESS-QUEEN_CHAR: My exhibition still lacks one final piece.
You returned again. Still don't know when to stop?
Why? That old woman will wake me again.
Remember this well: no matter how many times you come, there is only one ending for you.
...I'll remember. So when I claim you, I'll savor the weight of this exhibit.
I'm afraid your display stand cannot bear my weight.
Only one way to find out.
